description:
7th November - The kid’s yoga session focused on building flexibility, posture, and body awareness through a series of well-paced movements. We began with gentle warm-ups and transitioned into Tadasana, Bhujangasana, and Butterfly Pose to activate the spine and hips. Mountain Pose and hamstring stretches were included to improve balance and leg strength, followed by shoulder and upper body stretches to release tension. The children responded with enthusiasm, maintained good energy throughout, and showed improved coordination. Overall, it was an engaging and well-rounded session promoting both physical and mental well-being. Ended with chants
The project is coordinated and supported by Rtn Partner Priti Shroff.
Attended by 35 kids
Project cost Rs 500/-
